title: agent-platform definition inputs
description: The closed input set of the agent-platform capability. The renderer turns these inputs into the installation's fileset: the agent-platform configmap patch and the dex-app secret patch in the configs repository, the extras/agent-platform tree and the platform section of the Backstage config in the management-clusters repository. A key an installation carries that no input renders and that removals.yaml does not list refuses the render, naming the key. Annotations: x-source says where a value comes from (registry: read from the installations registry or the configs checkout, never typed; person: typed by the person enabling or reconciling; generated: created by the engine once and read back from the checkout afterwards). x-feature names the consistency feature of features.yaml the input's dimensions roll up to. x-renders lists the key paths the input produces, prefixed by the file: configmap (agent-platform configmap-values.yaml.patch), dex-secret and dex-configmap (dex-app patches), extras (extras/agent-platform/ in the management-clusters repository), backstage:app-config, backstage:user-values, backstage:kustomization, backstage:file (the Backstage directory). List indices are written [*], per-installation map keys <name>. A default is declared only where every enabled installation agrees.

installation.description: Facts about the installation that are on record. Read from the installations registry and the installation's config.yaml.patch; never typed.

baseDomain.description: The installation's base domain; every public hostname of the platform (muster, agentgateway, dex, kagent, avatars) derives from it.

customer.description: The owning organisation as the configs repository names it.

provider.description: The infrastructure provider; selects the Postgres backup shape and the storage class default.

private.description: The installation's API and ingress sit behind a private load balancer (managementCluster.private). Every allowPrivateIP knob of the installation's own components follows it.

chartLine.description: The meta chart line the installation runs (agentPlatform.kagentApiV2 in config.yaml.patch selects 4). On the 4 line the managers derive issuer, client and secret from the template's global.identity block and the manager oauth keys are not rendered.

musterClientId.description: The platform's Dex client id: services.muster.clientId of the installation's config.yaml.patch, else the shared default's. The template renders it; the definition never writes it into a patch, and an empty id refuses.

secrets.description: Names of the referenced Secrets the platform reads its credentials from. The engine creates each Secret in extras/agent-platform/secrets/ with generated values, encrypted for the repository's recipients, and names it in the patch. Every enabled installation uses the same names, hence the defaults.

musterOAuth.description: Secret with keys dex-client-secret, oauth-encryption-key and registration-token in the platform namespace.

musterValkey.description: Secret with key valkey-password, read by muster's session store and by the bundled Valkey.

kagent.description: The agent runtime: kagent with the platform Postgres, the kagent UI behind oauth2-proxy and Dex, inference routed through the agentgateway LLM listener.

enabled.description: Runs kagent and the platform Postgres. Renders the component switches, the model provider wiring (Secret reference and agentgateway base URL), the oauth2-proxy credentials Secret and its Dex client, and the portal's kagent entry for this installation.

modelKeySecret.description: Who provides the model provider key Secret the default ModelConfig references: managed renders it into extras/agent-platform/secrets/ from a value the person supplies; customer-provided renders nothing and the installation's owners create the Secret themselves.

defaultModel.description: Model of the default provider when it deviates from the template's.

additionalModelConfigs.description: ModelConfigs rendered next to the default one.

storageClass.description: Storage class of the platform Postgres where the cluster default is unsuitable. Omitted, the chart default applies.

postgresBackupAzureSubscriptionId.description: Subscription the Postgres backup bucket is provisioned in; capz installations only.

controllerResources.description: Resource requests and limits of the kagent controller when the chart defaults do not fit.

bundledAgents.description: The kagent chart's bundled sample agents to enable.

uiIngressPeers.description: Additional workloads allowed to reach the kagent UI's oauth2-proxy, by pod label and namespace.

identity.description: The platform's login and token trust beyond what the template renders from the installation facts.

loginConnectorId.description: Pins muster's Dex login to one connector. Giant Swarm's own installations only; the meta chart refuses a pin on a customer installation.

extraTrustedAudiences.description: Dex client ids whose tokens muster accepts as bearer tokens, on top of dex-k8s-authenticator, kagent and the portal clients.

trustedIssuers.description: Issuers other than the installation's Dex whose tokens muster accepts: the cluster's service-account token issuer for in-cluster agents, another Dex.

postLoginRedirectAllowlist.description: Targets muster may send the browser to after a connector sign-in, beyond the template's agentgateway completion landing.

publicRegistrationRedirectURIs.description: Redirect URIs a public client may register dynamically with muster.

additionalDexClients.description: Dex clients of the installation that are not the platform's own (kagent, portal, hub token exchange). Their secrets are generated.

portal.description: The developer portal's agent-platform section. The portal itself is the customer-portal definition's; this definition writes only what the platform contributes to it.

enabled.description: A developer portal exists for this installation. Renders the platform's muster entry, the agent-platform extensions and the avatars image source.

installation.description: The installation whose management-clusters tree hosts the portal, when it is not this one.

domain.description: The portal's hostname on this installation, when the portal signs people in on this installation's Dex. The dex-app configmap patch is one file with one owner: with the platform enabled this definition owns it, so it carries the portal's Dex client (id backstage, redirect URI https://<domain>/api/auth/oidc-<name>/handler/frame, secret referenced from the customer-portal definition's Secret dex-client-backstage) — the entry the customer-portal definition renders itself on an installation without the platform.

clientIds.description: Dex client ids of the portal instances that sign people in on this installation. Their main-login tokens are accepted by the kagent UI's oauth2-proxy, by muster, by Dex's authenticator client and, where the agentgateway validates JWTs at the edge, by its JWT policy.

skillsRepositories.description: Skill repositories the portal offers to agents. A private repository renders the token Secret its checkout needs.

aiChat.description: The portal's AI chat on the platform's model provider.

toolAccess.description: What agents and people reach through muster: the installation's MCP servers and the agent-manager.

privateURLs.description: The installation's MCP servers reach Dex on private addresses: their OAuth issuer URL and SSO JWKS fetch may resolve to private IPs. Renders each server's user values and the ConfigMap its HelmRelease reads them from. Not derived from installation.private: a public installation with an internal Dex route needs it too.

enabled.description: Runs the agent-manager as an MCP server on the platform. Its base URL, issuer, client id and Secret derive from the installation facts and the secrets input; on chart line 4 the identity keys are not rendered because the template's global.identity block carries them.

additionalServers.description: MCP servers registered with muster beyond the template's own-cluster kubernetes, prometheus and capi servers and the federated ones. Because a patch replaces the mcpServers list as a whole, the renderer emits the template's own entries again whenever this list or federation.targets is non-empty, and omits the key otherwise. An oauth server names the Secret with its client credentials, rendered next to it.

federation.description: Cross-installation access: this installation as a hub whose muster exchanges tokens for other installations' MCP servers, and this installation as a target of hubs. A private target is reached through the tunnel, which renders the tunnel release, the hub-side RemoteApp, the SPIFFE bundle trust and the portal's in-cluster kagent URL.

connectorId.description: The connector in every target's Dex that trusts this hub's issuer. Required when targets is non-empty.

brokerClientId.description: Dex client id of the hub's token-exchange broker client; registered once, read back from the checkout afterwards. Required when targets is non-empty.

targets.description: Installations this hub federates: a token-exchange target, an identity provider for the agentgateway, the target's MCP servers with exchange auth, and the hub-side credentials Secret per target.

baseDomain.description: The target's base domain: its Dex issuer and, for a public target, its MCP servers' hostnames derive from it.

private.description: The target sits behind a private load balancer and is reached through the tunnel: a RemoteApp per tunnelled app on this hub, the app's Teleport objects in teleport-fleet, the exchange pinned to the target's public Dex issuer.

tunnel.description: How this hub reaches its private targets: tbot workloads on this hub join Teleport and terminate TLS with a SPIFFE SVID in front of each tunnelled app. Required when a target is private; refused when none is.

jwks.description: This hub cluster's service-account signing keys (GET /openid/v1/jwks on the hub), the JSON document verbatim; every provision token the tunnel's bots join with embeds it. Public verification material, not a secret.

trustBundleProvisioned.description: Whether this hub's trust-bundle singleton (the role, bot, provision token and workload identity named tunnelport-trust-bundle-<hub>) already exists in teleport-fleet; false renders it.

teleport.description: The Teleport cluster the tunnel joins.

hubs.description: Installations whose broker exchanges tokens into this one. Each renders a token-exchange client in this installation's Dex and its place among the authenticator client's trusted peers.

chart.description: The meta chart release range when the installation deviates from the fleet base.

semver.description: Semver range patched onto the agent-platform OCIRepository.

muster.description: muster's own deployment knobs when the chart defaults do not fit.

klausGateway.description: The chat gateway component (Slack front door to the platform's agents, on-behalf-of connector links, A2A). Its Slack and OBO credentials render as referenced Secrets; its routes and URLs derive from the installation facts.

connectors.description: Offers connector links (sign in to a third party through muster) in the chat.

saTokenAudience.description: Audience of the projected service-account token the gateway presents to agents, when it authenticates with one.

allowedCallers.description: Service accounts allowed to open team reviews.

clusterManager.description: The cluster-manager component on a hub. Its installation name and base URL derive from the installation facts.

workloadClusterFqdnPatterns.description: FQDN patterns of the workload cluster API endpoints the manager may reach.
